response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actors FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - fa.avg_actors AS excess_first FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS fa WHERE fa.avg_actors IS NOT NULL AND ac.actor_count > fa.avg_actors), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actors FROM above_first) SELECT SUM(af.actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(af.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(af.actor_count - sa.avg_actors) AS avg_excess_second FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_average AS sa WHERE sa.avg_actors IS NOT NULL AND af.actor_count > sa.avg_actors
